applicability: CORE or Marketplace Portal accounts with the corresponding optional product records, service profile 4.1.0. Existing base product rules apply alongside these additional terms.
content:
An announced activation-linked correction changes the declaration capacity and version when the specified event occurs. Existing reservations become STALE and may be released. Reserving early is supported, but a payment cannot consume an outdated version merely because it once had enough capacity.

Detailed local effects and operation names: `RST-declarations`.

provenance.source: Primary-author synthetic extension of the frozen 4.0.2 business mechanisms; no claim of a verbatim source SOP rule.
